notes.title: patch 1.92
notes.notes:
Ported to the latest engine version for more stability and better performance.
 Ported to the Jolt Physics engine for better results and performance.
 The ui now scales with higher resolutions. Gone are the tiny fonts and ui elements.
 The font for the pilot names has also been changed to be more readable.

 As always minor fixes and improvements



Have fun!

notes.title: hotfix 1.81
notes.notes:
small fixes to the patch, including...


 reduced lag when squads appear on the map
 painting the aircraft, copying and favoring paintings now works again
 pilots now heal faster

notes.title: patch 1.8
notes.notes:
Ported to the newest eninge version for more stability.
 The way the textures of the aircraft are loaded into the game has been changed, which should significantly reduce RAM-related slowdowns. I'm looking forward to your feedback on how it works for you now!
 The free camera can now be locked to the selected aircraft.
 Aircraft now catch fire more easily and have a certain probability of going up in flames when they crash.
 There is now a slider at the start of the campaign that allows you to adjust the campaign duration.
 The newspaper articles should now all appear as intended.
 More differnet pilot names so that they are not repeated so often.
 As always minor fixes and improvements


If something does not work as expected you can switch back to version 1.7 via Steam.

Have fun!

notes.title: patch 1.7
notes.notes:
Added a spectator mode where you can simply watch the planes fight and move around freely with the camera.
 In the game folder you can now find a description for modding and also one that explains how to upload a mod to the Steam Workshop.
 The Brequet was linked to the model of the RE8 by mistake all the time. Now the model is acutally in the game.
 In the menu you have now options for FPS-lock and v-sync.
 In the Settings.txt (...\AppData\Roaming\Godot\app_userdata\Skies above the Great War) you can now change the screen resolution. However, full screen must be deactivated for this to work. Please keep in mind that the game is supposed to be played in 1920x1080.
 As always minor fixes and improvements

 The game also supports AI made Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic translations now. I hope the AI did a halfway decent job. If anyone notices major problems with the translations, please let me know, as I certainly don't want to offend anyone!



I will continue to work on the performance issues. Please be patient until the latest engine version is released. There are still a few stability issues with the current version.

notes.title: patch 1.6
notes.notes:
The strange behaviour of the game when pausing/unpausing should now be fixed.
 For those who have weird issues with the mouse, I've added an option to disable gamepad input. This should hopefully solve the problem.
 of course, as always, other small fixes

notes.title: patch 1.5
notes.notes:
repeated newspaper message for zeppelins fixed
 fixed the crashes of heavy bombers at start

notes.title: patch 1.4
notes.notes:
Ported to the latest Godot version (4.3 stable)
 You can now access a map while piloting an airplane if you want to focus on just flying.
 Fixed the bug that caused pilots to lose their skill progression (usually after loading the game). This also caused many of the strange behaviors where planes couldn't take off because they simply didn't have the skill to do so.
 Fixed multible bugs where the map would always stay on the screen, even in action mode, requiring a restart of the game.
 Squadrons finally fly home reliably before they run out of fuel.
 Again numerous small things, bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: patch 1.3
notes.notes: Ported to the latest engine version. Perhaps it will bring better system compatibility for one or the other.

notes.title: patch 1.2
notes.notes:
I was able to fix a memory leak which leads to less slowdown over game time.
 I've also introduced a few quality of life improvements based on your feedback.

notes.title: patch 1.1
notes.notes:
improved stability and elimination of some crash causes
 greatly improved behavior of the AI on the map
 slightly improved performance
 some minor improvements

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
The time has come, the Early Access status has ended. As far as I can see the game is more or less running smoothly and ok so far, even if there may still be some problems here and there which I unfortunately could not reproduce and therefore could not fix yet.

I will of course continue to support the game, don't worry. So if you notice any bugs please post them and I'll try to take care.

I would like to take this opportunity to thank you again for your great support. The game has got a small but very fine community with you and I hope that you will continue to play a round from time to time in the future and have fun with the game. If you haven't submitted a Steam review yet, I would of course be delighted if you did.

Have fun with the game!

notes.title: some more bugfixes
notes.notes: some more bugfixes, ui improvements and a tips&tricks section

notes.title: Last update before the final release
notes.notes:
The last causes of strange pilot behaviour and random crashes should now be fixed.
 The performance is now much better and the game runs smoothly and reliably (at least on my test systems).
 The war, and therefore the game, now ends after a time and the outcome depends on the player's success during the campaign.


Please report any remaining bugs or problems in the forum, on Discord or via mail.

As always, thank you so much for your patience and your support.

Have fun with the game!

notes.title: Early Access release
notes.notes:
The time has finally arrived for Skies above the Great War to enter the Early Access phase. Many thanks for the feedback. It has helped me a lot to get this far.
Please continue to let me know your thoughts on the game so that together we can complete it and make it a great piece of entertainment.

Have fun with the game!

notes.title: Alpha 2.0 release
notes.notes:
After 2 months of crunch time I was finally able to upload the alpha demo 2.0 of Skies above the Great War to Steam, just in time for the start of Steam Next Fest.
I completely rebuilt the game, also reworked all the models and created custom texture materials to make them look right in the now dynamic lighting.
Also, there is now a rudimentary campaign AI to play against. There are balloons to hunt down on the front lines and there is also a pilot training mechanic. The bombers can now drop their bombs and you can man their machine guns to fight back enemy attacks.
You see, a lot has been done. I am now looking forward to feedback and I really hope that one or the other has fun with the new demo.
